increment_paragraph: **OTEL-PROTO-PHASE-B1** (round 42, USER DECISIONS 2026-11-27 "New provider crate" and "Phase it, accept 7"; [report](../../reports/otel-proto-phase-b1/README.md)). ledger.text: AMENDED by OTEL-PROTO-PHASE-B1 (USER DECISIONS 2026-11-27 "New provider crate", "Phase it, accept 7"; option 1, phased): phase B1 is done. The shipped crate quirin-provider-fluent-otel-proto (providers/contract-load-path.json, the corpus index, cycle19-resource-contracts.json and the cmetrics, ctraces and fluent_bit library-provider lists) declares custody contracts for the 78 generated functions the OTel consumer units call (52 __init, 9 __get_packed_size, 9 __pack, 4 __unpack, 4 __free_unpacked) and the 4 protobuf-c runtime entry points (82 declarations, 2 modules written by its scripts/generate.py, which refuses a prototype or body that is not the protoc-c 1.5 shape of its family): __unpack an owned nullable result, __free_unpacked a nullable release, the rest borrowed. Every declaration is pinned (contracts.lock, 82 pinned at 046accf6 and 66910c10) to its generated definition and prototype, so a regenerated file holds it (contract-pin-mismatch, Unknown); protocol-identity.json pins the opentelemetry-proto identity and the 22 compiled generated and runtime files on the vendored v1.10.0 basis. No checker: the shipped load path carries no checker bindings (user decision 2026-11-16). No existing cmetrics, ctraces or fluent-bit declaration rests on the new declarations, so no linkage_contract_v1 link is required and none was added (a link to an unrecorded reliance is refused); a fixture shows an unlinked reliance on a generated release refused. Prediction (docs/reports/otel-proto-phase-b1/PREDICTION.md): the 7 accepted custody rows Unknown -> Safe on corpus and twelve-home, none on system or slice. What remains of this entry is B2+B3, now OTEL-PROTO-NULL-CONDITIONAL-READING. DISCHARGE: that entry's discharge.

ledger.title: The null model cannot read the protocol's conditional facts (element below a tested count, sub-message under a tested presence, member under a tested case)
ledger.text: Phases B2+B3 of OTEL-PROTO-PHASE-B as one analyzer card (USER DECISION 2026-11-27, "Phase it, accept 7"). The null walk refines only NULL tests (qcore-c-gateway src/null_deref/walk.rs condition): an integer or case comparison leaves the state not definite, and the protocol facts hold only for messages protobuf-c unpacked (encoders build the same types with NULL slots). The card adds: path state for index < count and case = number facts, with invalidation on writes and loop fixed points; a well-formed mark carried from a new unpack result clause (contract spec, grammar, frontend, Lean) through sub-message, element and selected-member reads; and a quant wellformed precondition inferred for OpenTelemetry-message formals and discharged at each call site, mirroring quant null-deref; each in new role-named modules with small hook points, Lean in QCore.OtelProtoObligations and QCore.NullDeref, placeholder-free. Prediction: the 17 null rows and 1 combined row bounded by OTEL-PROTO-AUDIT (corpus and twelve-home; cmt_decode_opentelemetry.c 11, cmt_encode_opentelemetry_batch.c 4, ctr_decode_opentelemetry.c ctr_span_set_links and span_set_events; combined cmt_encode_opentelemetry_batch.c request_data_point_count), none on system or slice. DISCHARGE: implemented and measured.
